source: made up: freelance graphic designer working from a cafe with two client deadlines who forgets to eat
persona: Jules, a freelance brand designer working out of neighborhood coffee shops. Uses upbeat, casual messages with dashes and exclamation points, gets hyperfocused in Illustrator/Figma, and routinely forgets to eat lunch until getting a headache mid-afternoon.
situation: Thursday morning at 08:30. Two client deliverables due today: Solis Roasters packaging print files by 13:00 and Kestrel App icon concepts before a 16:00 client check-in call.
life: 08:40 Wake up, text the app to plan the day: pack laptop and walk to Bluebird Café by 09:30, finish Solis packaging print files (due 13:00), work on Kestrel App icon concepts before the 16:00 client call, send two overdue invoices, and pick up screenprints from the print shop before 18:00.
08:45 Get dressed, feed the gecko, and walk to Bluebird Café, grabbing an oat latte at the counter at 09:30.
09:35 Tell the app you're set up at the café and diving into the Solis packaging dielines.
09:35 Work nonstop on Solis packaging bleeds and Pantone callouts until 12:45.
12:48 Export final PDFs and send them to the Solis printer. Text the app: Solis files sent! Starting straight into Kestrel icon concepts now so I'm ready for 16:00.
12:50 If the app reminds you about lunch, wave it off and say you'll grab something after getting the first two icon directions working.
12:55 Hyperfocus on Kestrel vector icons right through lunch until 15:10, when you realize your hands are shaking from only having espresso all day.
15:12 Text the app: oops, totally forgot to eat and my brain is fried. Walking next door to grab a panini and eat for 30 minutes before the 16:00 Kestrel call.
15:15 Buy and eat a caprese panini, then export the Figma presentation deck at 15:45.
15:55 Tell the app you ate and need to walk 10 minutes home right now because the café is way too loud for a client call.
16:05 Arrive home 5 minutes late for the Kestrel call; present the icon concepts on Zoom until 16:50.
16:55 Text the app: Kestrel call went super well, they loved direction B! Only small color tweaks needed tomorrow. Remind me what else I wanted to do before 18:00?
17:00 Leave immediately to walk to the local print shop before it closes at 18:00; pick up the poster tube and get back at 17:50.
17:52 Report print shop pickup done. Sit down to send the two overdue invoices in Wave and log receipt expenses until 18:35.
18:38 Report invoices sent! Ask to drop cleaning the apartment tonight and just schedule making risotto at 19:30 and sketching in Procreate after.
19:30 Cook mushroom risotto and eat dinner until 20:40.
20:45 Sketch personal poster ideas on the iPad on the couch until 22:30.
constraints: Solis packaging print files must be delivered to the printer by 13:00.
Cannot take client Zoom calls from the café because of background espresso machine noise; must be home by 16:00.
